executiveSummary: The latest Apple event showcased a mix of hardware releases, AI/ML developments, and industry shifts, with a focus on foldable devices, AI safety, and supply chain management.

takeaways.title: AI safety concerns
takeaways.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposes a three-step plan to 'pace the frontier' and ensure AI adherence to safety practices, citing the need for third-party evaluators like METR.

takeaways.title: Foldable device advancements
takeaways.description: Apple's iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro showcase advancements in foldable display technology, with the iPhone Duo featuring a new 'Shift Left Edge' setting to improve case compatibility.

takeaways.title: Supply chain management
takeaways.description: Reports indicate that Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders are experiencing delays, with the Apple Store down ahead of pre-orders and customers facing longer wait times.

worthWatching: The potential for AI to impact various industries, including healthcare and education, as mentioned in the article on AI safety concerns
The growing demand for foldable devices, driven by consumer interest in innovative smartphone designs, as highlighted in the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro releases
engineeringPerspective: The technical challenge of developing foldable displays, as exemplified by Apple's iPhone Duo, which requires advancements in materials science and display technology
The importance of supply chain management in ensuring timely device delivery, as exemplified by the delays experienced by Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders
